# Town of Newbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 16; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Newbury's selectboard as Andrew Lee, Shauna Prime, and Susan Culp (Chair)

Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the 2025 annual report's '2025 Town Officers' table seated Jeff McKelvey instead of Lee, and marks Prime appointed to a seat expiring 2026; Prime holds by the March 2026 election and is recorded elected with that appointment history noted. McKelvey is not recorded
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Chuck Schulze as Newbury's town clerk
Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the officers table carries Schulze as town clerk for a term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Mary Collins as Newbury's town treasurer
Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the officers table carries Collins as town treasurer for a term to 2028
Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the officers table marks the collector of delinquent taxes an appointed office in Newbury, held by Mary Collins, the town treasurer
Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the officers table lists listers Amanda Beaulieu (Chair), Janis Moore, and Dustin Putnam; Moore's printed expiry is 2026

Town of Newbury Board of Listers, minutes of March 4, 2026: the listers' own minutes of March 4, 2026 (the day after town meeting) seat all three listers, which carries Moore's incumbency past the printed expiry

Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the officers table lists auditors Jean Welch (elected), and Huntoon and Butler (appointed to vacancies), all with terms expiring 2026; the March 2026 outcome is published in no official source located, so the post is created without memberships and the three are held as stragglers

Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the officers table lists Moderator Janet Cole on a one-year term expiring 2026; the March 2026 outcome is published in no official source located, so the post is created without a membership and Cole is held as a straggler

Town of Newbury (official website), 2025 Annual Report: the officers table lists Constable Glen Godfrey with a term expiring 2026; the March 2026 outcome is published in no official source located, so the post is created without a membership and Godfrey is held as a straggler
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Newbury justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024

jp_election.name: Town of Newbury Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Newbury justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Amanda Beaulieu, Catherine Kidder, Patsy Cole, Jean Welch, Sarah Putnam, Art Morris, Ian Clark, Virginia Fuller, Mary Burnham, and Scott Labun. The town report prints 'Patsy Spear Cole'; the listing's form governs. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
